members.title: Members
members.empty: No members are available in this view.
members.roles_unavailable: Role choices are not available with your current access. Existing assignments are preserved.
members.roles_unknown: Some existing role labels are unavailable. Existing assignments are preserved.
members.prepared: Roles assigned while suspended take effect only if this membership becomes active.
members.revoke_hint: Revoking ends this membership permanently. It cannot be reactivated from this page.
members.suspend_hint: Suspension pauses access while preserving the membership and its assignments.

roles.read_only: You can view this role. Editing requires eligible institution-wide access.
roles.adopt_hint: This adds the listed permissions to this role. Previously removed permissions are not restored.
roles.release_current: No release adoption is available for this role.

permissions.settings: Manage institution appearance and invitation lifetime

failure.denied: This view is not available with your current account access.

failure.retry_after: Seconds to wait before trying again

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.create_hint: Send an invitation to this institution or branch with one offered role. Email is sent automatically.
invitations.email_hint: Use the email address the person will verify on their account.
invitations.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address: ASCII characters only, one @, and no spaces or consecutive dots.
invitations.invalid_role: No offered role was submitted. Return to the invitations page and choose a role.
invitations.role_kept: The role you chose is kept and is sent again with this form.
invitations.no_roles: No roles are currently available to offer with your access.
invitations.empty: No invitations are available in this view.
invitations.submission_accepted: Submission accepted by the mail server
invitations.delivery_hint: Mail server acceptance does not confirm inbox delivery or that the email was read.
invitations.uncertain_hint: The email may still arrive. Unfinished work continues to use delivery capacity; an unknown result is not a confirmed failure.
invitations.already_member: The person already had an active membership. Their existing roles and profile were preserved; the offered role was not added.
invitations.created_member: A new membership was created with the offered role.
invitations.role_unavailable: Offered role label is no longer available with your access.
invitations.role_changed: The offered role is no longer available with its original version. Revoke this offer and create a new invitation to choose the current role.
invitations.other_scope: This invitation is outside your current access context. Change account access to manage it.
invitations.reissue_hint: This replaces the current code and expiry. An older email can still arrive, but its code will no longer work. Unfinished earlier email work retains its delivery slot.
invitations.revoke_hint: This ends the offer. An email already in progress may still arrive, but it cannot grant membership.
invitations.policy_hint: Choose the lifetime for future invitations and explicit replacements. Existing invitation expiry times stay unchanged.
invitations.policy_stored: This institution has a saved lifetime policy.
invitations.policy_default: No policy has been saved. The default lifetime is 14 days.
invitations.policy_range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
invitations.policy_read_only: You can view this policy. Editing requires institution-wide settings permission.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.label: Field label
custom_fields.unsupported: This shape is unsupported. No answer can be submitted.
custom_fields.immutable: Published revisions are immutable. A successor never converts existing answers or transfers consent.
custom_fields.publish_hint: Publishing replaces the active revision linked below. Existing answers retain their original revision.
custom_fields.capacity: Limits: 20 active fields, 20 live drafts, 100 permanent keys and 1,000 retained revisions. Discarding releases only a draft slot.
custom_fields.input_budget: Authoring input must fit 4 KiB, including the schema (2 KiB), labels and notices. The encoded request must fit 16 KiB.
custom_fields.withheld: Answer withheld because current consent is absent.
custom_fields.incomplete: Missing required answers leave this form incomplete. Your account access is unaffected.
custom_fields.remove_hint: Removal works independently of required answers and consent. Withdrawal hides a value; removal clears it.
custom_fields.numeric_hint: Use decimal or exponent notation. Whole numbers must be within ±9,007,199,254,740,991. Overflow, lost integer precision and nonzero underflow are rejected.
custom_fields.value_budget: One submission: 4 KiB. Retained answers: 20 slots and 32 KiB, including historical revisions. Optional answers may be saved separately after required answers are complete.
custom_fields.consent_hint: Giving consent and saving an answer are separate acts. Consent alone does not save any answer. You may decline without losing existing access.
custom_fields.grant: Give consent to this exact notice
custom_fields.consent_history_incomplete: Consent history for this membership has not yet been checked.
custom_fields.consent_history_continue: Check this membership’s consent history and withdrawal
custom_fields.no_consents: No consent records on this page.
custom_fields.retained_entry: Manage retained consent, including former memberships
custom_fields.admin_consent: Only this person can give personal consent. An administrator cannot grant it on their behalf.
custom_fields.no_js_builder: Without JavaScript, this form edits text, whole numbers, numbers and yes/no fields. Enable JavaScript to use the prefilled visual editor for choices and nested fields.
custom_fields.advanced_hint: Only the supported finite profile is accepted. Labels are literal text, never HTML.
custom_fields.errors: Check the field key, explicit category, labels, bounds and byte limits. No change has been submitted.
custom_fields.no_js_answers: Answer groups and lists without JavaScript
custom_fields.no_js_answers_hint: Choose how many list items to include, then complete only the first that many items. For an optional answer, choose Yes to include it or No to leave it out. Other list items and excluded optional answers are ignored. Nothing is saved until you submit.
custom_fields.disabled_translations_hint: This save includes only enabled institution languages. Disabled translations are not carried into the draft; published revisions keep their original translations. Enter the label and any sensitive-data notice in the current default language.
custom_fields.required_first: Complete the missing required answers first. You can then edit other answers separately. Removing a retained answer remains available.
custom_fields.recovery_unavailable: This list shows nonempty input from your rejected request. Field details could not be reloaded for editing. Open the current view before preparing another change.
custom_fields.author_text_hint: Normal text saves new lines as line feeds. Exact line endings preserves carriage returns with \r, line feeds with \n, and backslashes with \\. Existing line endings are preserved. To use Normal text, first replace any \r escapes deliberately. Limits apply to the decoded text.
custom_fields.text_entry_hint: Normal text saves new lines as line feeds. Exact line endings uses \r for a carriage return, \n for a line feed, and \\ for a backslash. It preserves existing line endings. To use Normal text, first replace any \r escapes deliberately. Length limits count the decoded answer.
custom_fields.scalar_editor_unavailable: This revision uses choices or nested answers. Its prefilled visual editor above preserves the complete field; enable JavaScript to edit it.
